s: February 26, 2022 - Agree with the suggestion of rubbing the scratching post or whatever with catnip. And just adding on that if a cat doesn’t respond to catnip, you can try silver vine. I was surprised to learn that more cats respond to silver vine than even catnip. “In a 2017 study, almost 80% of cats were responsive to silver vine versus 68% of cats that responded to catnip. Approximately 75% of the cats that were unresponsive to catnip were responsive to silver vine.” For some reason kittens younger than 8 months and pregnant cats don’t respond to silver vine or catnip.
